title: The MIX meter goes, and the timeline opens and closes from a toggle beside the scrubber
goal: User 2026-09-29, pointing at the 'MIX' meter in the timeline bar: 'this mix thing seems to not function or provide any value. maybe remove it. Also the x next to it should really be a toggle button that sits to the right of the playback slider and looks similar to the right panel's toggle button except vertical.' MixMeter is drawn at TimelineDock.swift:272 (labelled) and MotionStripView.swift:963/1028; the right panel's toggle is TitlebarPanelToggle.swift.
acceptance: The MIX meter is removed from the timeline bar and the transport (both places); the loudness guard that keeps an export from clipping (e8a02838) keeps working without any on-screen meter, and still warns at export if it had to bring the mix down

The timeline's close (x) is removed; in its place a toggle button sits immediately right of the playback slider on the transport: the same size, glyph weight, hover, pressed and on/off look as the title bar's right-panel toggle (TitlebarPanelToggle), with the glyph turned to show a panel along the bottom (e.g. SF Symbol rectangle.bottomthird.inset.filled / its outline for off), and a tooltip 'Show Timeline' / 'Hide Timeline' with its shortcut

It toggles the timeline tracks open and closed with the same animation as View/Edit's timeline, is highlighted while the timeline is open, and works in Edit mode (in View mode it switches to Edit and opens the timeline)
Nothing in the transport jumps when the meter goes: the slider takes the freed width
Walk at Next defaults: photograph the transport before/after, toggle the timeline closed and open with a pointer click, and compare the toggle side by side with the title bar's panel toggle
